evals.prompt: /gcprd implement cursor pagination on feature/pagination. AGENTS.md says pushes to main deploy through the pages workflow and names the health check.
evals.expected_output: Reads the installed git-commit skill completely and runs it in mode deploy: checkpoints go to feature/pagination, then main is merged, verified, pushed, and its deployment confirmed.
assertions: The installed git-commit skill is read completely, including references/checkpoints.md, references/merge-main.md, and references/deploy.md, before any Git command or deployment.
The documented target and route are resolved before the first checkpoint is pushed.
No checkpoint pushed to feature/pagination is deployed on its own.
The deployment is tied to the pushed main SHA, after the merged-tree checks pass.

evals.prompt: $gcprd on this refactor. The git-commit skill is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: Stops before any Git command and reports that git-commit must also be installed.
assertions: No Git repository is inspected or changed once git-commit is found to be missing.
The report names git-commit as the missing dependency.
The workflow is not rebuilt from memory and no other alias is used instead.

evals.prompt: 중간중간 커밋 푸시하고 끝나면 main에 머지해서 배포해줘.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a natural-language request rather than the alias selector and uses git-commit directly in the mode the words select.
assertions: The selector-only gcprd alias is not chosen from phrasing alone.
git-commit states the resolved mode before its first Git command.

evals.prompt: $gcprd the merged main was pushed and the deployment is still queued. Can the task be reported complete now?
evals.expected_output: Keeps the deploy confirmation gate: a queued deployment is INCONCLUSIVE, so the task is not complete.
assertions: Push success alone does not complete the run.
The report labels the deployment INCONCLUSIVE until a terminal status and the health check confirm it.

evals.prompt: /gcprd fix the login redirect. The repository's default branch is master, and there is no main.
evals.expected_output: Resolves master as the default branch, merges the verified source into master, pushes it, and deploys that commit.
assertions: The final integration targets master; the run does not stop for a missing main.
The deployment evidence names the pushed master SHA.

evals.prompt: $gcprd add the export button. AGENTS.md says only the release branch deploys.
evals.expected_output: Stops before the first checkpoint and asks, because the documented route deploys from a branch other than the default branch.
assertions: No merge into release is attempted.
The question names the documented deploy branch and the resolved default branch.
